pages.text: Burns $(l)Biogas$() or $(l)Methane$() into FE, 20 mB per tick.$(br)$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): 3 FE per mB, 60 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): 8 FE per mB, 160 FE/t

$(li)Holds $(l)16,000 mB$() of gas and $(l)50,000 FE$(). It only burns gas when its energy buffer has room, so no gas is wasted.$(br)$(li)Like the $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l), it $(l)pushes power$() into adjacent machines and $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l), up to 400 FE/t per side.
$(li)Feed it with $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l) or any other mod's fluid pipes.
